units.evidence: Official management page identifies the full school host and explicitly emphasizes operations management and production management. Faculty section identifies management professors; no separate Operations or Management department is invented.

decisions.reason: Acronym-only data/business analytics and statistics recruiting subjects do not establish a named department. Separately verified operations-bearing school is retained in full.

Explicit operations and production management emphasis; expanded faculty section read.

limitations: Management is a major and faculty specialty within the verified school; no separate departmental title established. Imported abbreviations are not expanded speculatively.
